models.information_rate_note: p_hat*(1-p_hat)/median_call_seconds. A VARIANCE-PER-SECOND heuristic only: it says how much binary-outcome variance a model produces per second of wall clock, which is what a paired assay's power per unit compute scales with. It does NOT capture capability (it is maximised at p=0.5, so a better model can score lower), pairing, clustering, between-anchor correlation, the effect size under test, Lean's cost, or model load/reload cost. It is not a decision rule.
models.purpose: MODEL ELIGIBILITY CALIBRATION ONLY. One arm (R_A) was played; this artefact contains no comparison between representations and none can be derived from it.
